source("functions.R")

```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
source(here("01_functions","functions.R"))
```

# RONI index

```{r}
# Read into a tiblle

csv <- read_csv(here("00_data", "raw", "roni.csv"))

colnames(csv)

roni <- csv |>
  rename(
    date = 1,
    roni = 2
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    roni = na_if(roni, -9999)
  )|> 
  filter(
    date >= as.Date("2020-10-01"), 
    date < as.Date("2024-11-01")
  )
  

roni

ggplot(roni, aes(date,roni))+
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_minor_breaks = "1 month"
    ) + 
    annotate("rect", xmin = as.Date("2023-06-01"), xmax = as.Date("2024-05-01"), ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,         alpha = .2
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = as.Date("2024-06-01"), y = 1.5, label = "El Niño"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Date", 
      y = "Relative Oceanic Niño Index (°C)") +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) 
  
```

# T-air and Precipitation

```{r}
temp <- read_csv(here("00_data","processed", "t2m_1330_0130_solar_time.csv"))
temp

precip <- read_csv(here("00_data","processed", "monthly_total_precip.csv"))
precip
```

# LST data

```{r}
monthly_lst <- read_csv((here("04_output","monthly_lst.csv")))
monthly_lst<- monthly_lst |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(month_date),
    names_from = landcover,
    values_from = lst_monthly_mean
  ) |>
  mutate (
    mean_lst = (forest + open_land)/2,
    date = month_date
  ) 

monthly_lst
```

# Join RONI and Climate data and LST

```{r}
# join with the roni table
full <- roni |>
  full_join(temp, by = "date") |>
  full_join(monthly_lst, by = "date") |>
  full_join(precip, by = "date")

full
```

## Plot join

```{r}
# First restructure the data
df_long <- full |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(roni, t1330, mean_lst, precipitation_mm),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# Factor the variables, to define the order they will appear in the plot
df_long$variable <- factor(
  df_long$variable,
  levels = c("precipitation_mm", "roni", "t1330", "mean_lst")
)

# # Change the names for the plot
# df_long$variable <- recode(df_long$variable,
#                            temperature = "Air Temperature (°C)",
#                            roni = "Relative Oceanic Niño Index (°C)",
#                            precipitation = "Precipitation (mm)",
#                            mean_lst = "Land Surface Temperature (°C)")

# Then plot with facet wrap
ggplot(df_long, aes(date, value)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_minor_breaks = "1 month"
    ) +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1)
```
